articles.title: Can US Chip Controls Slow China’s AI Progress?
articles.description: Nvidia is at the center of a renewed debate over how much access China should have to advanced US AI chips. CSIS’s Emily Harding discusses whether export controls can meaningfully slow China’s AI progress without accelerating its domestic chip industry, what lawmakers should ask Jensen Huang when he testifies before Congress, and why technology companies increasingly need to think of themselves as potential national security targets. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: US Genesis Mission Looks to AI to Accelerate Science
articles.description: One year after the launch of the Genesis Mission, the US Department of Energy says the AI-driven initiative has grown to nearly 300 research projects spanning energy, biology, advanced manufacturing and national security. DOE Undersecretary for Science Dario Gil discusses using AI to simulate the power grid 1,000 times faster, efforts to accelerate nuclear and fusion development, and the goal of doubling the productivity and impact of US research and development within a decade. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Federal Circuit Affirms Noninfringement Ruling for Lowe’s and $25,000 Sanction Against Patent Owner’s Counsel
articles.description: The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (CAFC) on Monday affirmed a district court’s grant of summary judgment of noninfringement in favor of Lowe’s Home Centers, LLC in a patent dispute over light-emitting diode (LED) light fixtures. The CAFC also upheld a $25,000 sanction imposed on the patent owner’s attorney for violating a stipulated protective order and affirmed the district court’s denial of Lowe’s requests for attorney fees under 35 U.S.C. Section 285 and sanctions under 28 U.S.C. Section 1927. The post Federal Circuit Affirms Noninfringement Ruling for Lowe’s and $25,000 Sanction Against Patent Owner’s Counsel appeared first on IPWatchdog.com | Patents & Intellectual Property Law.
